title: Meet Lumi, the AI health coach at the heart of Lucis
summary: Lumi, our AI health coach, now at the heart of your Lucis Membership.
body_markdown:
## Not a chatbot. Your health partner.


Most health apps add a chatbot on the side. You type your question, explain your situation from scratch, and get an answer written for the average person.


Lumi works the other way round:


-


**It gets to know you from day one.** It starts with a health intake, but not another long form: it's a conversation about your health, your history and your goals, with follow-up questions on what you actually said.


-


**It already has your context.** Your results, your action plan, your lab visit, your orders and every conversation you've had, in one place. Nothing to upload, nothing to re-explain.


-


**It builds your plan with you, then helps you follow it.** From nutrition and meal plans to training and recovery, Lumi turns your results into practical next steps.


-


**It picks up where you left off.** Mention something and run out of time? Lumi keeps it and comes back to it next time. The more you use it, the better it knows you.


## What it looks like in real life


-


"Marathon in April. Build me a plan around my results."


-


"Plan me a week of 20-minute family dinners that fit my results."


-


"I'm flat by 4pm every day. What can I change this week?"


-


"My lab visit is Thursday. Do I need to fast?"


-


"What should I bring up with my doctor from my results?"


## Built with our medical team


Lumi answers from two places: your own data, and medical knowledge built and vetted with Lucis clinicians. Not whatever a general AI model happens to surface.


Our clinicians helped build it and review its medical answers in testing. Real conversations are monitored, and flagged issues are reviewed every day.


## Where it stops


Lumi is clearly an AI, not a person or a doctor, and it knows its limits:


-


It doesn't diagnose.


-


It doesn't prescribe, or tell you to start or stop a medication.


-


When something is worth raising with your doctor, it says so, and helps you work out what to ask.


Lucis works alongside your doctor and doesn't diagnose. Lumi's job is to help you make the most of the time you get with them.


## Already used Lumi?


Your past conversations are still there. What's new: Lumi now knows your full context from the start, gets to know you through the intake, builds your plan with you, and picks up where you left off.


Ask it the question you asked last time and see the difference.


## How to start


Lumi is included in every Lucis membership, from €199 a year, or under €17 a month. You can talk to it from day one, even before your lab visit. Open Lucis on the web and start a conversation.
